title: Surface critical errors in game exports for fast-analysis to catch
description:
When real unambiguous bugs happen during a game (e.g., server short ID collisions logged at SEVERE, uncaught exceptions in callback handling), these errors are only visible in verbose log files that nobody actively monitors.

We should record sufficiently-bad errors in the game export itself (e.g., an "errors" array in the JSON) so that fast-analysis and other automated tools can flag them. This makes it impossible to miss critical issues even if nobody is watching the logs.

Examples of errors worth surfacing:
- ShortIdRegistry server ID collisions (SEVERE log)
- Uncaught exceptions in callback handling
- Loop detector interventions
- Any error that indicates a genuine bug rather than normal LLM mistakes
